name: a locator that names nothing
composer: a chip edit three levels down
input:
<service verb="update" noun="Thing">
    <actions>
        <!-- the thing -->
        <entity-find-one entity-name="Thing" value-field="thing"/>
        <if condition="thing">
            <iterate list="thing.items" entry="item">
                <if condition="item.open">
                    <set field="item.state" value="closed"/>
                </if>
            </iterate>
        </if>
        <script><![CDATA[ec.logger.info("done")]]></script>
        <service-call name="mantle.Things.notify#Thing"/>
    </actions>
</service>
expected:
<service verb="update" noun="Thing">
    <actions>
        <!-- the thing -->
        <entity-find-one entity-name="Thing" value-field="thing"/>
        <if condition="thing">
            <iterate list="thing.items" entry="item">
                <if condition="item.open">
                    <set field="item.state" value="done"/>
                </if>
            </iterate>
        </if>
        <script><![CDATA[ec.logger.info("done")]]></script>
        <service-call name="mantle.Things.notify#Thing"/>
    </actions>
</service>

name: composer: a service-call's in-parameter as a field-map
input:
<service verb="update" noun="Thing">
    <actions>
        <!-- the thing -->
        <entity-find-one entity-name="Thing" value-field="thing"/>
        <if condition="thing">
            <iterate list="thing.items" entry="item">
                <if condition="item.open">
                    <set field="item.state" value="closed"/>
                </if>
            </iterate>
        </if>
        <script><![CDATA[ec.logger.info("done")]]></script>
        <service-call name="mantle.Things.notify#Thing"/>
    </actions>
</service>
expected:
<service verb="update" noun="Thing">
    <actions>
        <!-- the thing -->
        <entity-find-one entity-name="Thing" value-field="thing"/>
        <if condition="thing">
            <iterate list="thing.items" entry="item">
                <if condition="item.open">
                    <set field="item.state" value="closed"/>
                </if>
            </iterate>
        </if>
        <script><![CDATA[ec.logger.info("done")]]></script>

</service>
